_meta.indication: Radioactive diagnostic agent indicated for PET of PSMA positive lesions in men with prostate cancer with suspected metastasis who are candidates for initial definitive therapy, and with suspected recurrence based on elevated serum PSA level.

pivotal_trials.design: Prospective, multi-center, multi-reader, open-label, single-arm, non-randomized, single-dose study
pivotal_trials.population: Men with at least high-risk prostate adenocarcinoma who were candidates for prostatectomy with pelvic lymph node dissection
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Patient-level sensitivity and specificity for pelvic lymph node metastases by histopathology reference (co-primary)
pivotal_trials.n: 268 enrolled; 252 in the Evaluable Set for the primary analysis
pivotal_trials.result: Sensitivity 28% to 39% (lower bound of 95% CI 17% to 27%), specificity 95% to 98% (lower bound of 95% CI 92% to 95%), and PPV 72% to 81% (lower bound of 95% CI 56% to 62%), depending on reader; all three readers exceeded the predefined specificity goal of 80%, but none met the sensitivity goal of 40%.

pivotal_trials.design: Prospective, multi-center, multi-reader, open-label, single-arm, non-randomized, single-dose study
pivotal_trials.population: Men with biochemically recurrent prostate cancer and negative or equivocal conventional imaging
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint of correct localization rate (CLR)/patient-level PPV: percentage of subjects with one-to-one correspondence between a lesion on 18F-DCFPyL PET/CT and the composite truth standard
pivotal_trials.n: 208 enrolled (Full Analysis Set); 99 to 104 evaluable patients depending on reader

key_safety: Safety evaluated in 593 patients; most common adverse reactions were headache (13, 2%), dysgeusia (10, 2%), and fatigue (7, 1%). A hypersensitivity reaction was reported in one patient (0.2%). No deaths or study withdrawals related to adverse events occurred.
target_moa: Piflufolastat F 18 is a urea-based ligand that binds to the active site of PSMA, which is overexpressed in prostate cancer cells, and dose-dependently inhibits PSMA enzymatic activity in vitro with a Ki of 1.1 nM; the F-18 label enables PET imaging.

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because this drug is not the first in its class.

basis.text: Priority review status was requested and granted for this application.

citations.quote: NDA 214793 for piflufolastat F 18 was received by FDA on September 29, 2020, and filed on November 6, 2020. Priority review status was requested and granted.

summary.text: PYLARIFY was submitted as a 505(b)(1) NDA received September 29, 2020, granted priority review, and approved on the standard (non-accelerated) pathway based on two adequate and well-controlled trials (OSPREY and CONDOR); the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it is not the first in its class.
